author: Iguessimonredditnow
body: As you have the orns, build more shops, or refresh them with gold. Mostly you'll get them as drops from Mimics, so do lots of gauntlets/dungeons. Sometimes as daily/quest rewards.

author: ZettaPT
body:
I guess it depends on how you play; I consider myself very casual (I log on whenever I feel like it and I have no kingdom) and I managed to get 50 of those in my 8 days of cumulative playtime.

I think that number would raise drastically if you had a proper "shop farm" or you took part in kingdom raids. Before that's viable (and I'm guessing you're low level enough that it isn't), I'd say it's relatively rare.

body: Mostly from shops and bosses for me and if you want to save gold on refreshing the shops Google the lowest level shop they show up in and build and refresh those often

author: Eiroth
body: If you use them fairly regularly, you might not gain them very quickly. Unless you want to spend most game sessions restocking your shops, use them fairly sparingly.

author: ErTaiGa
body:
I played for a very long time very active and in my active days I always tried to have around 90-100 of them. I was playing on a daily basis for several months and only used them when I needed a specific drop from gauntlets and/or bosses and if I was driving with someone else driving while always using a max of 2/3 dowsing rods per session depending on how long the journey was. Even though I was doing raids frequently and 5-10 gauntlets daily from level 195-225 I was never able to go out with a noticeable + on these things, I always was having either under 90 or having made +-0 or such an unnoticeably low amount that I didn't pay attention. 
Also I build 15 shops and refreshed them with gold from time to time.
So I personally would consider them relatively rare, idk how there are so many comments here saying they find many of them...

Gold and silver coins are over 4k each, every other item is in thousands except the dowsing rod and the special raid boss items. I'm level 230 now still at 130 dowsing rods for several months already, just not as active anymore hence not even using them and still finding so few.
